purpose: Curated upstream sources for Knightfall game development and game-server operations. This catalog is not a claim that any project is deployed in production.

policy.cloudflareCompatibility: Docker, PHP, Ruby, JVM, and long-running Node server applications do not run directly inside the current Cloudflare Pages + Workers architecture. Use these as local references or host them separately.

projects.name: Hextris
projects.use: Polished replayable puzzle-game loop, responsive canvas/UI and high-score flow.
projects.integration: Reference first; review GPL obligations and assets before bundling.

projects.name: A Dark Room
projects.use: Atmosphere, resource progression, incremental survival and narrative pacing.
projects.integration: Strong reference for an original Ash-Fall survival game; preserve MPL notices for any covered files.

projects.name: Clumsy Bird
projects.use: Simple arcade physics, collision loops and restart flow.
projects.integration: Learning/reference code; verify current upstream license and third-party assets.

projects.name: Elevator Saga
projects.use: Simulation loop, objective-based levels and performance feedback.
projects.integration: Reference for a new logistics/simulation challenge.

projects.name: Agar.IO Clone
projects.use: Canvas multiplayer architecture and real-time state synchronization.
projects.integration: Do not deploy as-is; verify the actual upstream repo and license, and adapt server architecture for Workers/Durable Objects.

projects.name: Mindustry
projects.use: Tower-defense waves, resource economy, structures and upgrade progression.
projects.integration: Large Java project; reference mechanics, not a drop-in browser component. Verify current license.

projects.name: 0 A.D.
projects.use: RTS unit/faction design, combat and resource systems.
projects.integration: Large native game; reference only, not suitable for the current browser site as-is.

projects.name: Legend of the Green Dragon
projects.use: Persistent browser RPG characters, daily actions, quests and community progression.
projects.integration: Repository/license must be verified before cloning or reuse; study only until verified.

projects.name: Pterodactyl Panel
projects.use: Game server control-panel UX, role-based operations, consoles, files and schedules.
projects.integration: Design reference; requires separate compatible hosting and server daemon, not Workers.

projects.name: Pelican Panel
projects.use: Modern game-server panel and operational workflows.
projects.integration: Design reference; AGPL obligations apply to covered use, and it needs separate hosting.

projects.name: LinuxGSM
projects.use: Install, update, monitor and manage many dedicated game servers.
projects.integration: Useful if Knightfall later runs dedicated multiplayer servers on Linux; not for browser-only games.

projects.name: GameAP
projects.use: Game-server fleet management and operations UI.
projects.integration: Separate hosting required; evaluate security and deployment before use.

projects.name: PufferPanel
projects.use: Game-server management workflows and panel UX.
projects.integration: Separate hosting required; reference before any adoption.

projects.name: Gameyfin
projects.integration: Potential separate library service; not a browser game engine or Cloudflare Worker package.

projects.name: RomM
projects.use: Self-hosted retro-game library organization and metadata.
projects.integration: Do not import ROMs; user must supply legally obtained content. Separate hosting required.

projects.name: PKVault
projects.integration: Reference only. Pokémon is third-party IP; no franchise assets or branding should be copied into an original Knightfall game.

projects.name: Sunshine
projects.integration: Separate machine and streaming infrastructure required; not a current browser arcade dependency.
